dashboard.multiple_prompts_tip: You can send multiple sequential prompts
dashboard.instructions_placeholder: Example: Add a new FAQ accordion section on the home page with 4 expandable questions. Use Tailwind CSS and smooth animations.
dashboard.realtime_cache_calc: Real-time estimation with Gemini Context Caching

contexts.title: My Development Contexts
contexts.subtitle: Create and iterate on technical specs, architecture guidelines, and rules for the AI
contexts.create_modal_desc: The context will be reviewed by the validator and subsequently passed to Gemini to generate the technical plan.
contexts.directives_placeholder: Write architecture guidelines, design patterns, component standards, required styling, etc.
contexts.desc_placeholder: Brief summary of the context purpose
contexts.no_contexts_title: You haven't created any contexts yet
contexts.no_contexts_desc: Create your first context to provide detailed specs to the AI and save tokens with Context Caching.
contexts.iterate_desc: Modifying content increments the version number and re-initiates technical validation.
contexts.plan_status_ready: Technical plan approved and ready to use

validator.title: Validation Dashboard
validator.subtitle: Review, adjust, and approve code requests and contexts before sandbox execution
validator.approve_generate_plan: Approve Prompt & Generate Plan in Docker
validator.context_evolution_desc: This task is linked to context #{id} ({name}). Approving the plan merges the temporal context into the fixed context. Rejecting discards the temporal context.
validator.context_evolution_merged: ✓ The temporal context and this plan have been merged into the fixed context.
validator.context_evolution_discarded: ✕ The temporal context was discarded when the plan was rejected.
validator.modify_plan_prompt_placeholder: Describe what needs to be changed in the plan (e.g. 'Do not use Redux, use React Context API')...
validator.reject_modal_reason_placeholder: Explain why this request is rejected so the user can fix it...
validator.no_plans_title: No implementation plans in this section ({filter})
validator.no_plans_desc: When you approve a prompt in tab 1, the Docker sandbox will consult Gemini to develop the technical plan. As soon as it is ready, it will appear here for you to validate before making changes.
validator.task_linked_context: This task is linked to context #{id} {name}.
validator.context_evolution_notice: Upon Approving the Plan, the temporary context and changes of this plan will automatically merge into the fixed context (incrementing its version). If Rejected, the temporary context is discarded.
validator.ctx_phase1_desc: Review and edit text before approving. Upon approval, Gemini generates the Context Plan.
validator.ctx_phase2_desc: Validate the Technical Plan structured by Gemini. You can accept it definitively (becomes ACCEPTED for prompts), modify or reject it.
validator.no_contexts_in_filter_desc: When developers create or iterate context directives, they will appear here for supervision.
validator.ctx_directives_label: Directives Provided by User (Editable by Validator):
validator.prompt_reject_ctx_plan_reason: Specify rejection reason for Context Plan:
validator.ctx_active_info: ✓ Active context available for this user's prompts.
validator.repos_desc: By registering as a repository validator with your GitHub PAT, users can direct prompts to it. You will validate the changes, and the worker will clone, commit, and open PRs with your token.
validator.no_repos_title: You don't have accredited repositories yet
validator.no_repos_desc: Register as a GitHub repository validator to start receiving change requests and supervising Pull Requests.
validator.modal_pat_hint: The token must have read and write permissions on the repository (scopes repo or contents:write + pull_requests:write) to open PRs on your behalf.
validator.reject_prompt_modal_desc: Indicate the reason why this prompt cannot be processed so the user can correct it.
validator.reject_prompt_placeholder: Ex: The requested change is ambiguous or does not meet project guidelines.
validator.reject_plan_modal_desc: Indicate why this implementation plan is not appropriate (e.g. alters incorrect files, risky approach, etc.).
validator.reject_plan_placeholder: Ex: The plan proposes modifying central authentication configuration instead of the local component.
validator.plan_tech_text_desc: You can tweak or correct any section of the plan directly before requesting regeneration from Gemini.
validator.modify_plan_prompt_desc: Describe required changes in detail. Gemini will receive the edited plan along with these instructions to synthesize a new version.
validator.reject_context_modal_desc: Tell the user the reason why these context directives are rejected so they can correct them.
validator.reject_context_placeholder: Ex: Directives contain disallowed credentials or are ambiguous...
validator.ctx_plan_feedback_label: Feedback / Instructions for regeneration with Gemini (Optional)
validator.ctx_plan_feedback_desc: If you want Gemini to re-synthesize the context plan, specify changes. If empty, the direct changes above are saved.
validator.ctx_plan_feedback_placeholder: Ex: Emphasize hexagonal architecture conventions and add strict TypeScript typing rules...

admin.gemini_settings_title: Google Gemini AI Settings for Docker Runner
admin.gemini_settings_desc: Configure the API key and AI model used inside Docker containers to interpret prompts, apply code edits, and open GitHub PRs.
admin.gemini_key_hint: You can obtain it for free at
admin.gemini_model_desc: Model invoked by the Docker container to plan and edit code.
admin.docker_sec_line1: The Gemini API Key and GitHub tokens are injected only as ephemeral in-memory environment variables into vibe-runner.
admin.docker_sec_line2: Credentials are never stored or committed to GitHub repositories.
admin.docker_sec_line3: Changes are isolated within the container's temporary workspace and pushed to GitHub only in dedicated new branches (vibe/task-*).
admin.project_rules_placeholder: Technical guidelines that Gemini will apply to this repository...
admin.project_active_checkbox: Active repository (visible and selectable for users to submit prompts)
